hero.title: Central Tiffin Room: Bengaluru's Culinary Soul for Over a Century
hero.subtitle: Experience the iconic Benne Dose and timeless South Indian delicacies that have delighted generations at Central Tiffin Room.

about.title: The Enduring Legacy of Central Tiffin Room
about.paragraph1: Central Tiffin Room, affectionately known as CTR, is a legendary hotel deeply steeped in the hearts and history of Old Bengaluru. Incepted in 1920, we have spent over a century delighting patrons with our iconic Dosas, Idlis, and a variety of South Indian delicacies. Central Tiffin Room isn't just an eatery; it's 'The Emotion That Holds Old Bengaluru Together,' a timeless favorite beloved by all ages.
about.paragraph2: Our rich legacy, crafted by visionary founders and now carried forward by the 3rd generation baton carriers, Mr. Sandesh Poojari and Ganesh S Poojari, epitomizes culinary mastery and cherished tradition. As 'Bengaluru’s Best Benne Dose,' Central Tiffin Room has cast its vintage charm by consistently delivering the most delicious Benne Doses to the old town of Bengaluru, retaining the same authentic taste that patrons have loved for over 100+ years.
